sentences.en: I have a head and a face.
sentences.zh: 我有一个头和一张脸。

sentences.en: My eyes are on my face.
sentences.zh: 我的眼睛在我的脸上。

sentences.en: I see with my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我用我的眼睛看。

sentences.en: I have one nose and one mouth.
sentences.zh: 我有一个鼻子和一张嘴。

sentences.en: My ears are on the sides of my head.
sentences.zh: 我的耳朵在我头的两侧。

sentences.en: I have two hands and ten fingers.
sentences.zh: 我有两只手和十根手指。

sentences.en: My arms are long.
sentences.zh: 我的胳膊很长。

sentences.en: I have two legs and two feet.
sentences.zh: 我有两条腿和两只脚。

sentences.en: My teeth are white.
sentences.zh: 我的牙齿是白色的。

sentences.en: The skin on my hand is soft.
sentences.zh: 我手上的皮肤很柔软。

sentences.en: My hair is black.
sentences.zh: 我的头发是黑色的。

sentences.en: I have a heart in my body.
sentences.zh: 我的身体里有一颗心脏。

sentences.en: My bones are strong.
sentences.zh: 我的骨头很强壮。

sentences.en: I have a mouth and teeth for eating.
sentences.zh: 我有嘴和牙齿用来吃东西。

sentences.en: My neck connects my head to my body.
sentences.zh: 我的脖子连接我的头和身体。

sentences.en: My knees bend when I walk.
sentences.zh: 我走路时膝盖弯曲。

sentences.en: I have ten toes on my feet.
sentences.zh: 我的脚上有十个脚趾。

sentences.en: My tongue is in my mouth. I taste food with it.
sentences.zh: 我的舌頭在嘴裡。我用它尝食物的味道。

sentences.en: My chin is under my mouth.
sentences.zh: 我的下巴在嘴下面。

sentences.en: The brain in my head lets me think.
sentences.zh: 我头里的大脑让我思考。

sentences.en: The nerves in my arm send feelings to my brain.
sentences.zh: 我手臂里的神经把感觉传递到大脑。

sentences.en: My stomach is where food goes after eating.
sentences.zh: 我的胃是吃完食物后食物去的地方。

sentences.en: The muscles in my legs are strong.
sentences.zh: 我腿上的肌肉很强壮。

sentences.en: My chest is the front part of my body.
sentences.zh: 我的胸部是我身体的前部。

sentences.en: Blood is red and it moves through my body.
sentences.zh: 血是红色的，它在我的身体里流动。

sentences.en: A finger is on my hand. I have ten fingers.
sentences.zh: 手指在我的手上。我有十根手指。

sentences.en: A knee is in the middle of my leg.
sentences.zh: 膝盖在我的腿的中间。

sentences.en: A toe is at the end of my foot.
sentences.zh: 脚趾在我的脚的末端。

sentences.en: An ear is on the side of my head.
sentences.zh: 耳朵在我头的两侧。

sentences.en: An eye is for seeing.
sentences.zh: 眼睛用来看东西。

sentences.en: A bone is hard and white inside my body.
sentences.zh: 骨头很硬，是我身体里面白色的部分。

sentences.en: A muscle in my arm moves when I lift.
sentences.zh: 我手臂的肌肉在举东西时会动。

sentences.en: A nerve sends feelings from my skin to my brain.
sentences.zh: 神经将感觉从皮肤传递到大脑。

sentences.en: The leg is the long part of my body for walking.
sentences.zh: 腿是我身体用于行走的长长的部分。
